title: On Advancement
description: Checks when a player completes an advancement.

title: Spawn NPC
description: Creates an npc with the specified name and spawns it at the specified location as the specified type if it is set (default type is a player).

title: On Elder Guardian Appearance
description: Checks when an elder guardian appears in front of a player. (Paper)

title: On Enter Love Mode
description: Checks when an animal enters love mode.

title: Make NPC Attack
description:
Makes the npc start pathfinding to the specified livingentity & start attacking when they get close enough.
NOTE: You can stop this from occurring by using the CancelNPCPath effect.

title: On NPC Rightclick
description: Checks when an NPC is right-clicked.

title: On Entity Gateway Teleport
description: Checks when an entity is teleported through an end gateway. (Paper)

title: On Piglin Barter
description: Checks when a piglin is bartered with.
event_values: event-world, event-commandsender, event-entity, event-itemstack, event-object, event-location

title: On Player Gateway Teleport
description: Checks when a player is teleported through an end gateway. (Paper)
event_values: past event-location, event-block, event-world, event-player, event-metadataholder, event-teleportcause

title: On Raid Finish
description: Checks when a raid is completed by players.

title: On Time Skip
description: Checks when the time in a world is skipped.

title: Can Join Raid
description: Checks if the specified entity/entities can join a raid.

title: In Breed Mode
description: Checks if an animal is in breeding mode.

title: In Bubble Column
description: Checks if the specified entity/entities is/are in a bubble column.

title: On NPC Spawn
description: Checks when an NPC is spawned.

title: On Raid Spawn Wave
description: Checks when a raid spawns a new wave.

title: On Raid Stop
description: Checks when a raid ends and is not finished.

title: On Raid Trigger
description: Checks when a raid is triggered by a player.

title: On Unknown Command
description: Checks when an unknown command is executed.

title: On NPC Look Close
description: Checks when an NPC looks at a player with the lookclose trait.

title: Is Anchor Spawn
description: Checks if the respawn location of a player is a respawn anchor.

title: Is Patrol Leader
description: Checks if the specified entity/entities is/are a patrol leader.

title: Load Data
description: Loads the saved data of a player.

title: Save Data
description: Saves the data of a player.

title: Set Ability To Join Raid
description: Sets the entity/entities ability to join a raid to true/false.
syntax_pattern:
set [the] ability of [the] %entities% to join [a] raid[s] to %boolean%
set [the] ability of [the] %entities% to join [a] raid[s] to %boolean%

title: Set Patrol Leader
description: Sets the entity/entities ability to be a patrol leader to be true/false.
syntax_pattern: (set|make) [the] ability to be [a] patrol leader of %livingentities% to %boolean%

title: Caught Entity
description:
Returns the entity that's caught from the fishing event. (get)
May only be used in the PlayerFishEvent.

title: Make Villager Sleep
description: Makes a villager sleep at a location.

title: Make Horse Kick
description:
Makes the specified horse do the kicking animation for the specified players (through packets).
NOTE: You can stop this from occurring by using the StopHorseKick effect.

title: Stop Horse Kick
description: Makes the specified horse stop doing any animation (even if they're not currently doing the kick animation) for the specified players (through packets).

title: Make Horse Kick
description:
Makes the specified horse do the kicking animation for the specified players (through packets).
NOTE: You can stop this from occurring by using the StopHorseKick effect.
syntax_pattern: set [creeper] explo(de|sion) state of %livingentity% to %boolean% for %players%

title: On NPC Click
description: Checks when an NPC is clicked.

title: Delay of Block
description: Returns the delay of a block. (Must be a spawner)

title: Domestication
description: Sets/gets the domestication (temper) of a horse, skeleton horse, or zombie horse.

title: Fish State
description:
Returns the fishing state from the fishing event. (get)
May only be used in the PlayerFishEvent.
Fishing States: BITE, CAUGHT_ENTITY, CAUGHT_FISH, FAILED_ATTEMPT, FISHING, IN_GROUND, and REEL_IN

title: Fishing Experience
description:
Returns the experience gained from the fishing event. (get & set)
May only be used in the PlayerFishEvent.

title: Fishing Hook
description:
Returns the fishing hook (entity) from the fishing event. (get)
May only be used in the PlayerFishEvent.

title: Fishing Hook Max Wait Time
description:
Returns the specified hook's max wait time. (get & set)
Entity may only be a fishing hook (see Fishing Hook expression)

title: Fishing Hook Min Wait Time
description:
Returns the specified hook's min wait time. (get & set)
Entity may only be a fishing hook (see Fishing Hook expression)

title: Hook State
description:
Returns the specified hook's state. (get)
Entity may only be a fishing hook (see Fishing Hook expression)
Hook States: BOBBING, HOOKED_ENTITY, and UNHOOKED

title: Hooked Entity
description:
Returns the hooked entity of the specified fishing hook. (get & set)
Entity may only be a fishing hook (see Fishing Hook expression)

title: Max Domestication
description: Sets/gets the domestication (temper) of a horse, skeleton horse, or zombie horse.

title: Team by Name
description: Allows you to get the team type via an expression.

title: Horse Jump Strength
description: Sets/gets the jump strength of a horse, skeleton horse, or zombie horse.

title: On NPC Rightclick
description: Checks when a player rightclicks an npc.

title: From Spawner
description: Checks if an entity is from a spawner.
syntax_pattern:
%entities% (is|are) from a spawner
%entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) from a spawner

title: On Velocity Change
description: Checks when a player's velocity shifts.

title: On NPC Leftclick
description: Checks when an NPC is left-clicked.

title: On NPC Despawn
description: Checks when an NPC is despawned.

title: On NPC Create
description: Checks when an NPC is created.

title: Has Advancement
description: Checks if a player an advancement.

title: In Lava
description: Checks if the specified entity/entities is/are in lava.
syntax_pattern:
%entities% (is|are) in lava
%entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) in lava

title: In Rain
description: Checks if the specified entity/entities is/are in rain.
syntax_pattern:
%entities% (is|are) in rain
%entities% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) in rain

syntax_pattern:
%entities% (is|are) in water

title: Grant Advancement
description: Gives a player an advancement.

title: Remove All Potion Effects
description: Removes/deletes all potion effects from an entity.

title: Revoke Advancement
description: Gives a player an advancement.

title: Respawn NPC
description: Respawns an npc at the specified location if it has been despawned (see Despawn NPC effect).

title: Pause NPC Pathfinding
description: Temporarily pauses the NPC from completing any pathfinding tasks.

title: NPC Flight
description: Allows you to set the flight mode of the specified npc to false/true

title: NPC Skin
description:
Allows you to set the skin of the specified npc to the specified player's name (the string value).
NOTE: This only works if the npc's type is a player!

title: Make NPC Pathfind
description:
Makes the specified NPC start pathfinding to the specified location.
NOTE: If the NPC is unable to naturally walk to the location, it will teleport!

title: Lookclose trait of NPC
description: Allows you to set the lookclose trait of the specified npc to true/false
syntax_pattern: set look[ |-]close trait of npc %integers% to %boolean%

title: Equip NPC
description: Allows you to equip an npc with an itemstack. This is used for armor.

title: Delete NPC
description: Deletes an NPC's data and completely removes it from the server.

title: Despawn NPC
description: Removes the specified NPC from the world (doesn't delete data completely) but allows it to be respawned if needed (See Respawn NPC effect)

title: Is NPC
description: Checks if the specified entity is an NPC.

title: Delete/Unregister Team
description: Unregisters/Deletes a team

title: NPC Is Navigating
description: Checks if an npc is pathfinding/navigating.

title: Add/Assign Entity to Team
description:
Assigns an entity to a team.
NOTE: Entities are added to the team via their ID and players are added via their name.

title: Cancel NPC Pathfinding
description:
Stops the NPC from completing its pathfinding goal.
NOTE: This can also be used to stop an NPC from attacking.

title: Make NPC Follow
description:
Makes the npc continuously pathfind (follow) to the specified livingentity.
NOTE: You can stop this from occurring by using the CancelNPCPath effect.

title: Remove/Dismiss Entity from Team
description:
Removes an entity from a team.
NOTE: Entities are removed from the team via their ID and players are removed via their name.

title: Register Team
description: Registers/creates a team

title: Plugin of Command
description: Returns the name of the plugin that created the specified command.

title: Random Server Idea
description: Returns a random server idea

title: Team
description: Vanilla team

title: All NPCs
description: Returns a list containing the id of all npcs. (Loop-able)

title: All Teams
description: Returns a list containing the teams. (Loop-able)

title: Tool/Held Item of NPC
description: Sets/gets the npc's held item (main hand).

title: Size of Team
description: Returns the integer value of the size of the specified team.

title: Offhand of NPC
description: Sets/gets the item in the npc's offhand.

title: Prefix of Team
description: Sets/gets the prefix of the specified team.

title: NPC Id of Entity
description: Returns the id of the specified entity if they are an npc.

title: Last Spawned NPC
description: Returns the id of the last spawned npc (that was spawned via this addon)

title: Name of NPC
description: Sets/gets the name of the specified npc.

title: Hurt Sound of NPC
description:
Sets/gets the hurt sound of the specified NPC
NOTE: Can only be used if the NPC's type is not a player. Additionally, this value will return <none> if it has not been set.

title: Glowing of NPC
description: Sets/gets the glowing state of the specified npc.

title: Display Name of Team
description:
Sets/gets the display-name of the specified team shown in /team list.
NOTE: The original name of the team will still need to be used when modifying the team in any way.

title: Color of Team
description:
Sets/gets the color of the specified team.
With 2.0, colors are no longer strings.
1.0 COLORS: red, dark_red, blue, dark_blue, aqua, dark_aqua, dark_purple, light_purple, black, white, yellow, gold, gray, dark_gray, green and dark_green

title: Collidability of NPC
description: Sets/gets the collidability of the specified npc.

title: Unpause NPC Pathfinding
description: Unpauses the NPC and allows them to complete any previously assigned pathfinding tasks.

title: Ambient Sound of NPC
description:
Sets/gets the ambient sound of the specified NPC
NOTE: Can only be used if the NPC's type is not a player. Additionally, this value will return <none> if it has not been set.

title: Death Sound of NPC
description:
Sets/gets the death sound of the specified NPC
NOTE: Can only be used if the NPC's type is not a player. Additionally, this value will return <none> if it has not been set.

title: Team of Entity
description: Gets the team of the specified entity.

title: Glow Color of NPC
description:
Sets/gets the glow color of the specified NPC.
With 2.0, colors are no longer strings.
1.0 COLORS: red, dark_red, blue, dark_blue, aqua, dark_aqua, dark_purple, light_purple, black, white, yellow, gold, gray, dark_gray, green and dark_green

title: Silent State of NPC
description: Sets/gets the silent state of the specified NPC.

title: Sneak State of Player
description: Sets/gets the sneak state of the specified player(s)

title: Sprint State of Player
description: Sets/gets the sprint state of the specified player(s)

title: Suffix of Team
description: Sets/gets the prefix of the specified team.

title: Vulnerability of NPC
description: Sets/gets the vulnerability state (whether they can be damaged or not) of the specified NPC.

title: Entries of Team
description:
Returns a list containing the entries in the specified team. (Loop-able)
Note: If the server restarts or the entity is despawned for some reason, a non-player entity will most likely not be returned.
